name: web-change-community-asymmetric-portrait-grid-duotone-orange-teal
title: 'Change, Community' asymmetric duotone portrait grid in splattered orange and teal with bold headlines
whatItIs: A dark portrait-heavy layout with paint-splatter textures, five duotone (orange/teal) portraits in an asymmetric offset grid, numbered corner badges, headlines ('Achange, Community,', 'Find Out Acre', 'Take Action Action.') and a bold CTA button at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Urgent and raw; splattered duotone portraits in an uneven grid feel activist and unpolished on purpose.
techniques: Duotone portraits in two clashing bold colours.
Break the grid into deliberately uneven, offset blocks.
Add paint-splatter texture for a grassroots, non-corporate feel.

vocabulary.definition: An image rendered using only two colours.
A layout grid with deliberately uneven block sizes.
